actingAs: You are signed in as {name} ({email}). Everything you do here is recorded against your own account.
actAsDesc: You will see the panel exactly as they see it, and you can change things. Every action is recorded against your own account. The session ends by itself and cannot be extended.
noScreensDesc: This account holds no roles, so there is nothing it can open. Ask an administrator to assign one.
errorLoadStaff: Could not load the staff list
errorActAs: Could not sign in as that person
signInDesc: Staff accounts only. There is no sign-up — ask for an invitation.
forgotDesc: We will email you a link. It works once, and expires.
forgotSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
passwordDesc: At least 12 characters. Nothing else is required.
resetDone: Password changed. Sign in with it.
ordersDesc: Everything the kitchen is working on right now.
ordersLiveTip: Connected — status changes arrive as they happen.
ordersOfflineTip: The live connection dropped. The board is refreshing every 20 seconds instead.
ordersSearchHint: Search by order code, pickup code or customer name
ordersEmptyPaidDesc: Paid orders appear here on their own — nothing to refresh.
ordersEmptyStageDesc: Other stages may still have orders waiting.
ordersEmptyFilteredDesc: No order matches these filters. Check the counts on the other stages — it may be sitting in one of them.
orderCancelDesc: Nothing has been charged yet — only an unpaid order can be called off. The customer is told immediately, and the order leaves this board for good.
orderQrDesc: Scan it instead of typing the order's full code — a handheld or a phone reads it straight into a search box.
orderQrHint: The same code is written below, because a scanner is not always to hand.
historyDesc: Everything that has happened to this order, oldest first.
historyBackfilled: Recorded before this order's history was kept — only its creation time is known.
historyReconstructed: Reconstructed from the order itself — the status and the time are known, who made the change is not.
historyEmptyDesc: Changes to this order will appear here.
errorLoadHistory: Could not load the order history
menuDesc: Prices, availability and dishes, one branch at a time.
menuNoBranchesDesc: A menu belongs to a branch. Add one from the Restaurants tab first.
menuBranchUnreachableTitle: That branch is not one you can see
menuBranchUnreachableDesc: This link names a branch outside your reach — whoever sent it works somewhere you do not. Open the Menu tab for one of your own.
menuEmptyDesc: A branch with an empty menu cannot take orders — it has nothing to sell.
menuNoMatchDesc: Try another menu tab, or clear the search.
menuAvailableOnTip: Customers can order this. Turn it off to hide it.
menuDeleteDesc: This removes the dish from the menu for good. If it has ever been ordered, mark it sold out instead — the API will say so.
menuHistoryDesc: Everything that has happened to this dish — who added it, who changed the price, who marked it sold out. Oldest first.
menuHistoryEmptyDesc: This dish was changed before its history started being kept, or has not been changed at all. The next edit will appear here.
newDishDesc: It goes on the menu straight away, so add it priced and ready.
newDishNameHyHint: Every other language falls back to this one.
newDishPhotoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. A dish cannot go on the menu without one.
editDishDesc: Changes reach the app straight away. Orders already placed keep the price they were bought at.
editDishPhotoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Choosing one replaces the picture customers see.
dishPrepMinHint: Minutes. Leave it empty and the branch's own average stands in.
dishPhotoAlt: The photo chosen for this dish
dishPhotoWrongType: That file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image
dishPhotoTooLarge: That photo is larger than {mb} MB
restaurantsDesc: Your restaurants and the branches under them.
restaurantsSearchHint: Search by restaurant name, slug, or a branch name or address
restaurantsNoMatchDesc: No restaurant or branch matches these filters.
restaurantsEmptyDesc: Roles are held over a restaurant or a branch. Ask an administrator to assign one.
restaurantAdminsEmpty: This restaurant has no admin yet. Invite someone from the People tab.
branchTeamHint: Open a branch to see who works there
branchTeamEmpty: Nobody is assigned to this branch yet.
teamFailed: Could not load who works here.
branchesNoneCanCreate: No branches yet. A restaurant needs one before it can have a menu or take orders.
branchesNoneReadOnly: No branches yet. Ask an administrator to add one.
branchOpenTip: Customers can order from this branch.
branchClosedTip: Closed. Customers cannot order from this branch.
branchNoMenuTip: This branch has no dishes yet — it would be open and selling nothing.
newBranchDesc: A new branch of {restaurant}. It opens closed, so you can build the menu before taking orders.
newBranchNameHint: Falls back to the city if you leave it empty.
peopleDesc: Who works here, and what each of them can reach.
peopleSearch: Name, email or where they work
peopleSearchHint: Search by name, email, or the name of a restaurant or branch
peopleNoMatchDesc: No one here matches those filters.
peopleNotInReachDesc: That person does not work anywhere you can see. Clear the filter to search the people you can.
peopleWithdrawDesc: Their link stops working immediately. You can invite them again at any time.
peopleEmptyDesc: Staff accounts exist only by invitation — there is no sign-up.
peopleNoRoles: No roles — this account can sign in and see nothing.
peopleRemoveDesc: They lose everything that role reaches, and any session they have open ends. Their account and other roles stay.
activityEmptyDesc: Menu edits, orders moved and people invited will appear here.
activityNoneYetDesc: Nothing has been recorded for this account since activity started being kept.
activityOpenDish: Open this dish on the menu
activityOpenOrder: Open this order on the board
activity_menu_item_price: Changed the price of {name} from {from} to {to}
activity_branch_status_prep: Changed the prep estimate to {to} min
errorLoadActivity: Could not load this person's activity
inviteDesc: They get an email with a link to set a password. There is no other way to create a staff account.
inviteScopeNone: A platform role reaches every restaurant.
inviteGranted: {email} already works here; the role was added.
dashboardDesc: How the platform is doing, and what needs reconciling.
dashboardNoPaidOrders: No paid orders in this period
dashboardReconciled: Nothing to reconcile — every payment matches its order.
mismatchCount_one: 1 order does not match its payment.
mismatchCount_other: {count} orders do not match their payments.
dashboardMismatchAction: Each one needs a person to look at it.
customersEmptyDesc: Accounts appear here as people start ordering.
customersNoMatchDesc: Phone numbers are stored in full but shown masked — search the whole number.
customersGoneDesc: That account no longer exists. Clear the filter to see the rest.
customersRevealPhone: Show {name}'s full phone number — this is recorded
errorRevealPhone: Could not show that phone number
customerOrdersDesc: Everything this customer has ordered, newest first. Open one to see it in full.
customerOrdersSearchHint: Search this customer's orders by order code, a dish on the order, or where it was bought
customerOrdersEmptyDesc: This account has not ordered anything.
customerOrdersNoMatchDesc: No order of theirs matches this. Check the counts on the other tabs — it may be sitting in one of them.
errorLoadCustomerOrders: Could not load this customer's orders
platformDesc: New restaurants, and promo codes for customers.
newRestaurantNote: The slug becomes a public URL on the website, so it cannot be changed casually.
newRestaurantAdminHint: They do not need an account yet — this sends an invitation. Leave it blank and invite someone later.
newRestaurantWithAdmin: Created {slug} and invited {email} to administer it
newRestaurantNoAdmin: Created {slug}. Invite an administrator from the People tab.
newPromoNote: Goes to every verified customer. Re-issuing the same code tops up accounts that joined since, and skips those who already have it.
